source: For a traveling wave, speed v equals frequency f multiplied by wavelength λ. If you know any two positive values, you can calculate the third, provided all quantities describe the same wave in the same medium.

source: The main answer remains an exact fraction when necessary. Its decimal companion rounds to twelve places and uses an approximation sign when digits are lost. This is useful for thirds, repeated divisions and financial examples where a rounded display should not replace the exact calculation.
